name: Pastelería Ideal

name: Costra
description: Erick Magaña's Narvarte sourdough bakery supplies loaves to many cafés in the city. Best sellers include sugar-topped conchas, cinnamon rolls, peasant bread and dulce de leche bread; seasonal rosca de reyes and pan de muerto are sought after. Time Out rated it 4/5 and notes a recent move a few blocks from the original.
special_quality: The sourdough bakery that many other CDMX cafés quietly buy from.
address: Universidad 482, Narvarte Poniente (verify; another source lists Universidad 371-B after a recent move)
